question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given phrase.

One who goes from place to place, begging
solution:
The correct answer is Option (4) i.e. **'Mendicant'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **One who goes from place to place, begging: **(वह जो जगह-जगह जाकर भीख मांगता है)
 
• **Mendicant:** (भिक्षुक) - A person who lives by begging.
 
 
• **Example:** The mendicant was a common sight in the ancient city, moving from door to door.
 
 
 
• **Mendicant **correctly describes someone who lives by begging, which makes it the correct answer.

Therefore, the correct answer is **'Mendicant'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Misogamist:** (विवाह विरोधी) - One who hates marriage.
 
• **Malleable: **(नमनीय) - Capable of being shaped or bent.
 
• **Meticulous: **(सावधानीपूर्वक) - Showing great attention to detail.
